brief:
Israeli forces are preparing a gradual pullout from Hebron, according to the Walla news website, the Ma'an news agency reported. The planned withdrawal would represent a shift in the military's posture in the occupied West Bank city, though no timeline for the operation was specified.

Details regarding the scope and conditions of the withdrawal remain unclear. The announcement comes amid ongoing tensions in the occupied Palestinian territories.
title: Israeli military prepares phased withdrawal from Hebron
